column1: ## Repository Table R2. Training-resource genetic principal components
## Description: Final-resource coordinates, source cohort and five-category ancestry. Record numbers are file-local; coordinates retain their released precision.
## Source: S2 row order; S1-PC classifier labels with the internal Chinese cohort annotated as EAS.
## Missing values: NA means unavailable or not applicable, never a zero score. Numeric values retain source precision.
## Access: File-local record numbers do not establish anonymity; no identity mapping is included.
## Column 1 | Record | File-local row number; not a participant identifier.
## Column 2 | PC1 | Released first principal component; unchanged.
## Column 3 | PC2 | Released second principal component; unchanged.
## Column 4 | Source cohort | Source cohort membership, distinct from ancestry.
## Column 5 | Ancestry category | EUR, AFR, EAS, SAS or Others.
## Column 6 | Label source | Cohort annotation for the internal Chinese cohort; otherwise the S1-PC classifier.
